dataset_note: Entirely fictional synthetic user feedback for an interview demo; no customer or employer data.

feedback.comment: I installed the CLI but could not find what successful first run should produce.
The sample workflow failed and I could not tell which step should be retried.
I need to see which steps require a person to review before the agent sends anything.
I already use scripts and need proof this tool saves supervision time.
The run history is difficult to explain to a teammate who was absent.
I want a ready-made first task template instead of starting from a blank prompt.
